replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset. Next, you compute the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. The eigenvectors are the principal components, and the eigenvalues represent the variance of the data along each principal component.
